options.name: fetch_only
options.description: Fetch and verify files and create C(/bsd.upgrade) but do not reboot. Set to V(false) if you want C(sysupgrade) to reboot. This causes the module to fail. See the examples.

options.name: installurl
options.description: OpenBSD mirror top-level URL for fetching an upgrade. By default, the mirror URL is pulled from C(/etc/installurl).

options.name: keep_files
options.description: Keep the files under C(/home/_sysupgrade). By default, the files are deleted after the upgrade.

options.name: snapshot
options.description: Apply the latest snapshot. Otherwise release is applied.
